HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.

4. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.

5. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   C. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.

   A. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.

   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

10. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   B. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

12. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   C. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

14. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

----
